text: The purpose of this report is to provide the Board with a general status update on the three theatres (Sony Centre for the Performing Arts, St. Lawrence Centre for the Arts, Toronto Centre for the Arts).

The Board of Directors of Civic Theatres Toronto: 1. Approved the Mission and Vision statements, as noted in Confidential Attachment 1. 2. Approved the timeline for the marketing and branding work back schedule, as noted in Confidential Attachment 1 (Appendix 2). 3. Requested: a. the Policies and Priorities Committee to consider and provide input to staff with respect to the marketing and branding, as noted in the Confidential Attachment 1 (Appendix 2); and b. the President and Chief Executive Officer, Civic Theatres Toronto to report to the Board on March 22, 2018 with recommendations arising from the Policies and Priorities Committee's input. 4. Confirmed its actions in closed session issuing additional instructions to staff. 5. Directed Confidential Attachment 1 to remain confidential as it pertains to the security of the property of the municipality or local board.
